cohort: The study included 7564 women from the first wave of data collection of the Millennium Cohort Study.
finding: Women with elevated pre-pregnancy BMI (overweight, obese class I, and obese class II and III) incurred significantly higher hospital costs of childbirth compared to women with a normal BMI.
mod_finding: Delivery method, pre-term delivery, and length of hospital stay accounted for the observed difference in childbirth costs.
